title: Augmented strict adic reduction under ringed open extension
statement:
Let $e:W\hookrightarrow T$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion] and let $A,I,P_n=A/I^n,A_T,A_W$ be the completed coefficient datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with $n\ge1$. Identify $A_T|_W=A_W$ and $(P_n)_T|_W=(P_n)_W$ by [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. Let $e_!$ mean sheafification of the extension presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], on modules, complexes and strict towers. For every $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_W))$ there is a canonical natural isomorphism in $D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(T))$
$$\rho_{e,K}:(e_!K)_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}e_!(K_\bullet).$$
For a flat-term K-flat representative $P$ of $K$, it is represented by the actual strict complex map whose $n$-th component is
$$(e_!P)\otimes_{A_T}(P_n)_T\longrightarrow e_!\bigl(P\otimes_{A_W}(P_n)_W\bigr),\quad [p]\otimes b\longmapsto[p\otimes b|_W].$$
Brackets denote the extension-presheaf summand indexed by a map to $W$, followed by sheafification. The map is independent of the representative after localization. It commutes with every quotient transition, and with the quotient augmentations $\Delta(e_!P)\to(e_!P\otimes(P_n)_T)_n$ and $e_!\Delta P\to e_!(P\otimes(P_n)_W)_n$, both $p\mapsto p\otimes1$. At level $n$ it also identifies reduction as $(P_n)_T$-modules, before restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. For $b\ge a\ge1$ it respects the quotient normalization $(K_b\otimes^L_{(P_b)_W}(P_a)_W)\cong K_a$, including the equal-index unit and three-index cocycle of the datum. No completeness of $K$ or quasi-compactness of $e$ is required.
